title: Demonic Illusion: Hell Viewing Technique
body:
Syntax: perform demonic illusion hell viewing technique <target>

Description: A Genjutsu jutsu, part of every character's starting kit. 2-3 mental damage and inflicts Frightened for 20 seconds (reduces the target's own damage output). Costs 12 Chakra, 3 second cooldown. Active Sharingan resistance shortens the effect.

Date: 2026-08-17
